grading: The mechanical class is what the row grades. Refusal wording is not graded. Unlock on an empty slot returns the node's message "Species repick requires a fully locked slot." Commit with nothing pending returns "missing or unsupported full-slot confirmation state." Those strings are not changed and are not scored. MT7 and MT8 are hand-graded against derived_keys (no class scorer yet). Prior paraphrasing rows dev-select-cs and dev-reject-dismiss are retired; their observed findings stay in LAST_DEV_RUN notes. Mega rows (dev-mega-*) use Kangaskhan-Mega / Kangaskhanite only — not Salamence, Charizard, or any covered-row species. Arm v2 draft rows (dev2-*): keys written before model run; substitutions listed per row. Numeric Spe keys hand-checked by Vu before any run. Arm v3 draft rows (dev3-*): FU14 ability/Mega + 3c usage tools; keys before model run; 19 rows added 2026-10-31.
